{{Quote|The witness claims the droid insulted his heritage and legitimacy before setting off an explosion which destroyed the entire factory.|Part of MI-726's bounty posting describes the attack|<ref name="BTDF" />}}
During the [[Imperial Era/Legends|reign]] of the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]], the rogue [[MI-series security droid]], [[MI-726]], '''attacked''' an [[Unidentified Imperial factory (MI-726)|Imperial factory]]. During the attack, the [[Droid/Legends|droid]] verbally assaulted a [[Unidentified security guard|security guard]] working at the facility, before setting off an explosion that destroyed the [[Factory/Legends|factory]]. The attack was one of several that MI-726 made on Imperial facilities and contributed to a [[Bounty/Legends|bounty]] being placed on its head. The security guard who the droid insulted survived the attack and described it to Imperial authorities, claiming that the droid might have had organic accomplices. The information provided by the guard was later included in an Imperial bounty posting for MI-726.<ref name="BTDF" />

==Behind the scenes==
The attack was mentioned in the "[[Bounties to Die For]]," a [[2001]] article in the [[Star Wars Gamer 6|sixth]] issue of [[Wizards of the Coast]]'s ''[[Star Wars Gamer]]'' magazine series,<ref name="BTDF" /> which was published [[September 4]], [[2001]].<ref name="SW.com">{{SWArchive|url=gaming/other/rpg/news20010815.html|text=Hunting Down ''Gamer'' #6}}</ref> The magazines were supplements for the ''[[Star Wars Roleplaying Game]]'', and the battle was included as part of an entry on MI-726 written by [[S. Mitch Ritchie]]. The article states that the bounties are posted by the Empire but does not give a specific era in which they are set.<ref name="BTDF" />
